notes.title: Version 1.3.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]New:[/h2]
Added option to turn XInput off for players that want more than 4 controllers.
Go to Settings > Controllers > Toggle XInput On / Off
(With XInput off you may find triggers do not behave correctly with some controllers however you can also grab using the bumpers which appear unaffected)


[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Drink More Glurp Out Now!
notes.content:
Dust off those controllers and get ready for some party game madness... sponsored by Glurp!

Drink More Glurp is out now:

[list]
[*] Local multiplayer - hot seat - for up to 20 players
[*] All you need is one controller - or you can attach multiple controllers
[*] Thousands of possible event and brand combinations
[*] Sponsors randomly appear and twist the events to suit their agenda
[/list]

Also includes a single player challenge mode with online leaderboards and replays!

We hope you enjoy playing together and laughing at each other flailing about.


Come join us on Discord if you want to chat to us about our mad game: https://discord.gg/8qP8XuM
